"This class is defined in the "client_subsystem" diagram"
"This class is defined in the "client_subsystem" diagram"
"ChannelSystem is a facade that only delegates to managers. The
command system must use it as the only entry point to the channel
subsystem and must never call managers directly. Every facade method
is an independent operation and never sends messages; replies and
notifications are the responsibility of the command system."
